<div class="project-card">
<div class="card-top"><div class="card-badges"><span class="badge b-wip">Complete</span></div></div>
<div class="card-title">AI-Driven KYC Onboarding &amp; Compliance Engine</div>
<div class="card-sub">LangGraph · OSINT Agent · OCR / Face-Match / Liveness · Config-Driven Routing</div>
<p class="card-desc">Architected a three-stage, jurisdiction-aware onboarding pipeline (behavioral fraud gate
→ OCR / face-match / liveness verification → OSINT compliance agent) as a single generator function reused,
unmodified, by both a live streaming API and a CLI batch script, with zero duplicated business logic.
Config-driven country routing adds a new jurisdiction with one JSON entry, no new code branch. Built a
<strong>LangGraph-orchestrated</strong> compliance agent screening applicants against a real 7,495-entry OFAC
sanctions list (fuzzy name / DOB matching), live adverse-media and court-record search, with a local LLM
(Ollama) producing a LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH risk summary — keeping the sanctions match deterministic and
independent of the LLM output to bound hallucination risk in a compliance-critical decision.</p>

  <span class="tag">Ollama</span><span class="tag">Python</span>

## Hackathon Demo {#hackathon}

<div class="project-card">
<div class="card-top"><div class="card-badges"><span class="badge b-done">Complete · JLL Internal</span></div></div>
<div class="card-title">GPT-Powered Web Data Extraction Platform</div>
<div class="card-sub">LLM · Flask · Selenium · Runtime Code Generation · Azure</div>
<p class="card-desc">Built at an internal JLL hackathon following the public release of GPT-3.5. A Flask
web platform that lets non-technical analysts extract structured data from <em>any</em> website — no code
required. Under the hood: <strong>Selenium</strong> renders dynamic JS pages, <strong>BeautifulSoup</strong>
parses the loaded HTML, and <strong>GPT-3.5 on Azure</strong> generates Python extraction code at runtime
using <code>exec()</code> — inferring the page structure from user-provided sample values.</p>
<div class="card-tags">
  <span class="tag">GPT-3.5</span><span class="tag">Flask</span><span class="tag">Selenium</span>
  <span class="tag">BeautifulSoup</span><span class="tag">Azure OpenAI</span><span class="tag">Runtime Code Generation</span><span class="tag">Python</span>
</div>
<div class="video-label">Demo Recording</div>
<video controls preload="metadata"><source src="videos/hackathon_demo.mp4" type="video/mp4"></video>
</div>

<script>
const API_URL = 'https://rag-search-engine-5swz.onrender.com';
async function runSearch() {
  const query = document.getElementById('search-input').value.trim();
  if (!query) return;
  const resultsEl = document.getElementById('search-results');
  resultsEl.innerHTML = '<p style="font-family:\'DM Mono\',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--text-3);">Searching...</p>';
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/search?query=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&limit=5`);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error();
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!data.results || !data.results.length) {
      resultsEl.innerHTML = '<p style="font-family:\'DM Mono\',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--text-3);">No results found.</p>';
      return;
    }
    resultsEl.innerHTML = data.results.map((r, i) => `
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:1rem;padding:0.4rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);">
        <span style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--text-3);min-width:16px;">${i + 1}</span>
        <span style="flex:1;font-size:13px;color:var(--text);">${r.title}</span>
        <span style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--text-2);">${r.score.toFixed(2)}</span>
      </div>`).join('');
  } catch {
    resultsEl.innerHTML = '<p style="font-family:\'DM Mono\',monospace;font-size:11px;color:#f87171;">Backend offline — deploy to Render and update API_URL.</p>';
  }
}
document.getElementById('search-input')?.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') runSearch(); });
</script>
